Build the temporal mean part for a family group (internal)

Source: R/buildmxPedigrees.R
dot-pedigreeMeanPart.Rd

Build the temporal mean part for a family group (internal)

Usage

.pedigreeMeanPart(
  fsize,
  obs_ids,
  label,
  mean_basis = NULL,
  mean_hist = NULL,
  parent = "ModelOne"
)

Arguments

fsize

Family size.

obs_ids

Character vector of individual IDs.

label

The mean parameter's label, used only for the constant-mean case.

mean_basis

NULL for a single free mean (default), or the name of a fixed basis matrix in the group model whose columns the mean is regressed on.

mean_hist

NULL, or the name of the historical-moderator matrix to add to the mean.

parent

Name of the sub-model holding B_mean/G_mean.

Value

An mxMatrix or mxAlgebra named "M".
